7281.title: Thread deletion yields between database purge batches
7281.rootCauseOneLine: Historical finalization synchronously cascaded through thread history; trusted main queues a durable, bounded, yielding purge since merged PR #7184.
7281.proposedFix: No new PR: trusted main already contains the paced purge repair from #7184, confirmed with a second clean-checkout run.
7281.caveats: Synthetic 16,384-event in-memory workload; reporter disk database, exact installed build, EACCES recovery, FTS redesign, and checkpoint outlier not reproduced.
